landing.title: Understand your land. Measure vegetation. Estimate carbon potential.
landing.subtitle: Draw a plot, add your trees or crops and get a transparent, open-data view of vegetation condition and potential carbon benefit — with every assumption visible.
landing.trustLine: Results are scenario estimates with uncertainty ranges — never issued carbon credits.
landing.fourStepsSubtitle: From a boundary on a map to a readiness checklist.
landing.step1Text: Draw it, drop a pin with its size, type coordinates or import a file. It stays private.
landing.step2Text: Species, count and planting year — measurements if you have them.
landing.step3Text: Open satellite data gives land cover, NDVI and climate context.
landing.step4Text: A range, its uncertainty and what evidence is still missing.
landing.threeNumbersSubtitle: We never add these together. Example: the synthetic demo mango orchard (2.13 ha, 420 trees).
landing.environmentalBenefitText: Estimated annual carbon removal in tCO₂e/yr with low, central and high values.
landing.indicativeValueText: Scenario estimate only. This is not an issued carbon credit.
landing.otherIncomeText: Fruit, timber, intercrops and incentives — from your own records and public statistics.
landing.builtOnSubtitle: Every dataset keeps its own licence and attribution.
landing.regionsSubtitle: Rules, units and programmes come from regional configuration.
landing.regionIN1: Green Credit Programme ≠ carbon credits (CCTS) — separate mechanisms
landing.regionEU2: Certification required; estimates are never automatically certifiable
landing.privacyText: Exact polygons are private. The optional explanation receives derived indicators only — never coordinates. Carbon numbers are always calculated deterministically; no language model ever computes them.
landing.modeDeterministicText: Open data, documented equations, reproducible results.
landing.modeAiText: When the server enables it, a language model may rephrase explanations and agent messages from indicators such as area, NDVI and the estimate range — never coordinates, never new numbers.
landing.footerLicense: Apache-2.0 code and docs · QGIS plugin GPL-2.0-or-later · datasets under their own licences

panel.title: Selected plot details
panel.removalInfo: Low–high range of annual carbon removal from the tree-biomass model (IPCC 2006 Tier 1 parameters). The range reflects parameter uncertainty; it narrows as you add measurements.
panel.vegetationInfo: NDVI from the latest cloud-free Sentinel-2 scene over the plot. Sparse < 0.3, moderate 0.3–0.6, healthy ≥ 0.6.
panel.readinessInfo: How much of the evidence a recognised programme typically needs is already in place. It is a checklist score, not an eligibility decision.
panel.note: Numbers are scenario estimates with ranges. Green Credits and carbon credits are separate mechanisms in India.
panel.noPlot: Add your land on the map to see its details.
panel.approximateNote: Approximate boundary — draw the exact edges for a better estimate

cards.notCredit: Scenario estimate — not an issued carbon credit.

results.title: Carbon potential
results.pill: Scenario estimate only. This is not an issued carbon credit.
results.marketNote: Market-value scenario — not guaranteed revenue. Prices are illustrative placeholders for local price discovery.
results.neverSummed: These three values are reported separately and never summed.
results.cumulativeSubtitle: Band shows the low–high range; line is the central estimate.
results.improveIntro: Programmes differ, but these items are almost always requested. Each one you add narrows the estimate range.
results.improve_dbh: Measure diameter at breast height (1.3 m) on a sample of at least 30 trees; record the date and tape used.
results.improve_baseline: Collect land-use records before planting: previous crop, satellite images or official land records.
results.improve_management: Keep a management log: irrigation, pruning, fertiliser, replanting and tree losses by year.
results.improve_height: Measure average tree height with a clinometer or a height pole on the same sample trees.
results.improve_mortality: Count dead or removed trees each year to document survival.
results.improve_generic: Record this evidence with a date and a responsible person so it can be verified later.
results.policyDisclaimer: Initial screening only — not an eligibility determination.
results.separateMechanisms: Green Credits (GCP) and carbon credits (CCTS) are separate mechanisms.
results.plainWordsNote: Only derived indicators were sent — no coordinates. Provider: {{provider}}.
results.noEstimate: Add trees to the plot to get an estimate.
results.changeOverTimeSubtitle: Monthly mean NDVI over the plot
results.changeOverTimeEmpty: No monthly vegetation data for this plot yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies to labels and number formatting. Units and identifiers are never translated.
settings.unitsAuto: Regional default (ha for IN/EU, acres for US)
settings.privacyText1: Plot polygons are stored as private objects; public listings and shared links expose only a centroid rounded to 0.05°.
settings.privacyText2: The optional explanation receives derived indicators (area, tree count, NDVI, estimate range). Coordinates, polygons and addresses are rejected by the API schema.
settings.privacyText3: Carbon numbers are calculated by deterministic engines with cited methodologies. No language model ever computes a carbon value.
settings.imageryIntro: Choose the satellite or aerial imagery the map shows for {{place}}. Imagery is for viewing; automated analysis only runs where the licence allows it.
settings.imageryEnvOverride: VITE_SATELLITE_TILES_URL is set for this build, so that imagery is used instead.
settings.speciesReferenceText: Species parameters behind the estimates, with their verification status.
settings.aiNarrationHow: Set by whoever runs the server (ATLAS_AGENT_REASONER). An optional language model may only rephrase agent messages from derived facts; numbers always come from the calculation engines and coordinates are never sent.
